verdict.rationale: Secureframe's own docs say Trust Center data, such as monitoring checks on security controls, is pulled continuously from the platform (docs-64), so control status updates without manual work. Shadow-IT detection keeps the internal vendor list current (docs-11), but nothing shows that list feeding a public subprocessor list on the Trust Center. Nothing covers automatic document renewal on the Trust Center either. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor list sync to the Trust Center, automatic document renewal/refresh on the Trust Center, independent or hands-on corroboration.
